question: To which center should the seed and kuṇḍalinī be led?
premises: The seed and kuṇḍalinī are the objects to be moved.
The command chakra is the destination.
inference: One should lead the seed and kuṇḍalinī to the command chakra.
plain_english: O goddess, one should lead the seed and kuṇḍalinī to the command chakra.
